adversarial_audit.objection: Positive triangle holonomy removes every sign gauge.
adversarial_audit.resolution: A line has no cycle in the bipartite incidence graph; all nontrivial invariants run through several planes.

adversarial_audit.objection: Restricting to rich planes makes the gauge debt sparse.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False: only 2K+1 points become isolated and the rich cycle rank remains Theta(4^K).

adversarial_audit.objection: Every cohomology class is naturally realizable.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The combinatorial classification supplies possibilities, not the distribution induced by symmetric-group recoupling.

adversarial_audit.objection: A nontrivial scalar cycle forces poor PGM success.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Conditioning depends on weighted matrix traffic and bad-mode mass, not merely existence of one frustrated cycle.

claim_gate.reason: The missing natural theorem concerns a quadratic family of long inter-plane cycles and their matrix-valued extensions.

falsifiers_triggered: Single-plane positive-holonomy audits cannot establish a global gauge or frame edge, even on the rich support family.
The all-positive Steiner surrogate is one gauge class among 2^Theta(4^K) combinatorially admissible classes.
Future finite audits must include multi-plane incidence cycles and report gauge-invariant cycle products.

proof_obligations.resolution: Standard graph cohomology gives one independent bit per incidence cycle after point and line gauges.
Exact point degrees and crossing-graph connectivity give the rich component and cycle-rank formula.
No theorem yet evaluates the longer cycle products of natural S_n cup/cap and Racah contractions.
The admissible gauge space has Theta(4^K) dimensions; a local-plane argument cannot control it.
Multiplicity spaces require nonabelian O(m) connection holonomies and operator-valued cycle moments.

summary: Classified the scalar inter-plane gauge obstruction and proved that the pattern-rich hierarchy retains Theta(4^K) independent cycle bits despite every local plane being positive.

theorem_contract.gauge_classification: Incidence-edge signs modulo point and line basis signs form H^1 of the bipartite point-line graph, of dimension E-V+c.
theorem_contract.negative_cycle_witness: The F_2^2 quotient signing has a negative six-cycle on the embedded four-coordinate rich subsystem at every K>=4.
theorem_contract.rich_connectivity: Weights 2 through K-2 form one component: each such subset crosses a two-subset, and the two-subsets form connected Johnson graph J(K,2).
theorem_contract.rich_point_degree: For 1<=w<=K-1, a weight-w point has rich degree (2^w-2)(2^(K-w)-2)/2; the all-ones point has degree zero.
